scope: Factual documentation readback of the two Fable clauses only; no general scan, approval or product execution.

originalFableFinding.classification: Runtime fix accepted by Fable; two documentation clauses identified as non-blocking overstatements.

observations.originalWording: Any other value is taken as typed, as before
observations.replacement: Other values follow the ordinary form validation path.
observations.explicitLimitation: A declared variable's JSON Schema may accept an own `__proto__` member that the form's copy can omit.
observations.actualReadback: The new wording no longer promises that every accepted value is retained as typed. It expressly describes the admitted declared-variable schema case that can lose the own member and points it to #527.
observations.sourceEvidence: entryValueRefusal returns no message when the copied value is unchanged or when the record/value schema accepts it; stripUnset copies object entries by assignment. VariableDeclarationsSchema is a SlugSchema-keyed record of JsonSchemaSchema, which is a record of unknown values.
observations.testEvidence: structure.test.tsx test beginning at line 290 enters an admitted declared-variable schema containing the member, expects no inline invalid/held issue, and checks only the neighboring type with toMatchObject at line 308. It does not assert preservation of the entire object.
observations.qualification: This source/test readback supports the stated limitation, not a complete stored Variables round trip. No new runtime proof of #527 is claimed.

observations.originalWording: while the entry's own key is refused, the value is held with
observations.codexReplacement: When the Codex override's own key also violates its rule, the Value first names that key. Correcting it exposes the nested member error.
observations.keySchemaReplacement: For a record whose key schema rejects the key, the value schema determines the Value's feedback.
observations.actualReadback: The new prose confines the Key-prefixed priority to the Codex override record-key check and separately describes a key rejected by its key schema.
observations.sourceEvidence: entryValueRefusal first branches on !shape.key.safeParse(key).success and then uses shape.value.safeParse(value) feedback. Otherwise the record schema is checked and an entry-key issue may receive Key prefix. JsonText revalidates held text using the current validation callback/version.
observations.testEvidence: structure.test.tsx lines319-329 uses Bad key plus a refused array value, expects the value-schema refusal and explicitly excludes Key Bad key from the Value description; an accepted object value under that bad key is not marked invalid.
observations.qualification: No browser or tests were run for this editorial readback; these are inspected assertions and source branches, unchanged from runtimeSource.

parkedFollowup.title: Preserve all admitted JSON members when editing a declared variable schema
parkedFollowup.scope: Whole admitted declared-variable JSON preservation, including form output, saved draft and reloaded Value. The issue explicitly notes that the current mounted assertion does not compare the whole object.

limitations: Only the two requested documentation clauses and their scoped code/tests were read; no new general review or sign-off.

No product build, tests, browser, GraphGoblin API server or model-provider execution was performed, and no source/index/ref or remote data was modified. The only service read was the explicitly recorded GitHub issue lookup.
The docs-only child has no runtime/test delta. Existing runtime QA remains attributed to runtimeSource, not newly executed at this child.
Live #527 parking was verified, but its unresolved behavior was not implemented or runtime-retested.
